title: NATO Drafts Plan to Defeat a Russian Attack With Drones and AI
detail: Bloomberg reports that NATO's top military commander is drafting a strategy for a quick victory against a Russian attack on the eastern flank, built around drones and AI, with the plan due to be presented in Poland on October 12. It comes as Russia tests the alliance and Washington's Europe force posture review (due to conclude in December) leaves allies uncertain about the US contribution.
